card.name: Ends of long words in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long medical word written in ALL CAPS, such as PAT-IENT, REA-CTIONS, SYMPTOM-S or ANEM-IA, in boxed warning text.

modes.label: Capitalized word endings
modes.description: Final piece of an all-caps medical word inside a warning, where a space and the next word follow.
modes.example: IF A PAT<<IENT>> IN THE COURSE OF TREATMENT

modes.label: Warning heading words
modes.description: The ending of REACTIONS in the all-caps heading HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS INCLUDING ANAPHYLAXIS.
modes.example: WARNING: HYPERSENSITIVITY REA<<CTIONS>> INCLUDING ANAPHYLAXIS See full

card.writes: It pushes up code-style name pieces and pushes down all-caps words, so it seems to steer the output away from continuing in capitals.
card.plain: It notices when a long capitalized word in a boxed warning has just been completed.
